records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the Metropolitan Police Service Dedicated Ward Officer Abstractions and Strengths dataset. The current listed file covers August 2021 through July 2026 and is updated monthly. On 27 November 2025 an additional Ward Codes column was added; MPS states those codes are derived from team names and may not precisely align with the exact areas they cover. This batch binds the verified Campden ward code E05009390 to that unused public-safety source window without claiming an extracted Campden row, geometry, parcel join, or parcel progress.
